title: Fleet Performance Superintendent
description:
As a
 **Fleet Performance Superintendent** 
 at
 **BSM,** 
 you will be responsible to monitor and provide timely advice for improving the Operational Performance of the fully managed fleet using all available resources for optimising efficiency, reliability and competitiveness.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitors and supports the Company’s drive towards its goals in technical reliability and energy efficient operation, thereby assisting its Clients achieve and maintain their competitive edge.
* Helps develop the Company’s proprietary software platform using existing methodologies as directed by supervisor.
* Monitors and refines modelling methods so as to ensure the software platform always maintains BSM’s lead among competitors.
* Explores software and hardware solutions that can improve the reporting, modelling and analysis quality.
* Ensures the implementation of the performance monitoring system across the fleet.
* Monitors adherence of the ships to predefined reporting frequency and quality standards. Provides guidance and support to the ship’s staff as required.
* Provides support and guidance to the SMC wherever retrofitting of equipment is required and follows up the installation \& implementation process.
* Provides expert advice to the responsible SMC based on the performance analysis results.
* Provides regular reports to Fleet Management.
* Provides suggestions for expanding the performance monitoring portfolio.
* Supports the SMCs with Client specific performance monitoring systems, issuing formal guidance wherever required.
* Supports the COO office team with Analysis Reports related to the fleet’s performance.
* Supports S.M.C. and Clients with the selection of Makers at the newbuilding stage by providing advice based on documented performance records.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* MSc in Marine Engineering and/or Naval Architecture or equivalent
* Preferably 1 year in the technical department of a ship management/owningcompany,shipyard,researchfacilityorClassification society
* Experience with model tests, shop tests and/or sea trials considered a big advantage
* Minimum of five years’ sailing experience


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Very strong analytical skills
* High IT proficiency, preferably with programming knowledge
* Very good project management and organisational skills
* Open to new ideas and keen to challenge convention
* High level of organisation, attention to detail, and problem\-solving ability
* Team\-oriented, proactive, and safety\-focused approach


**Why You Should Join Us!**
 We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
   

  

* On\-the\-job training.
* First\-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
* Diverse workforce.
* Technology\-driven company.
* Be a part of the ever\-growing Schulte group family!
